Perfectly Al Dente
Aug 2026 • Solo
had a lovely time at Bottega5. the food was excellent and the service was beyond perfect. for someone coming in solo, there was barely any wait time and the staff was incredibly attentive to my needs.

please do order the Seafood Ravioli and Tiramisu. the pasta was perfectly al dente and the bright, fragrant tomato sauce paired so so well with the raviolis. all while being seasoned to perfection. for Tiramisu, you can expect a rich, creamy texture that satisfies that exact craving for something sweet (but not too sweet) after a great meal.

location was easy to find for it’s right in the expat area, you can enjoy a walk to the beach right in front of it after the meal, too! the atmostphere is quite cozy with yellow lights and extremely comfy chairs. a wonderful experience overall 10/10!
